Es durchstreift sein Revier und
markiert Bäume, die Früchte
oder Beeren tragen, mit Kratzern.

it.name: URSARING
entry_text:
Nel suo territorio, lascia graffi
sugli alberi che hanno bacche
o frutti deliziosi.

es.name: URSARING
entry_text:
Araña los árboles de su territorio
que dan bayas y frutas que le
gustan para marcarlos.

jp.name: リングマ
entry_text:
なわばりにある　おいしい　きのみや
くだものの　なる　き　には
ツメで　きずあとを　つける。

en.name: UXIE
entry_text:
When UXIE flew, people gained the
ability to solve problems.
It was the birth of knowledge.

fr.name: CREHELF
entry_text:
On l’appelle “être du savoir”.
On raconte que son regard a le
pouvoir d’effacer la mémoire.

de.name: SELFE
entry_text:
“Das wissende Wesen”.
Es soll die Erinnerungen derer
löschen, die ihm in die Augen sehen.

it.name: UXIE
entry_text:
Noto come “Essere della
conoscenza”. Pare che faccia per-
dere la memoria a chiunque lo fissi.

es.name: UXIE
entry_text:
Se le conoce como el “ser de
la sabiduría”. Se dice que puede
borrar la memoria con una mirada.

jp.name: ユクシ－
entry_text:
ちしきのかみ　と　よばれている。
めを　あわせた　ものの　きおくを
けしてしまう　ちからを　もつという。

en.name: VAPOREON
entry_text:
Its cell composition is similar
to water molecules. As a result,
it can melt away into water.

fr.name: AQUALI
entry_text:
Il a évolué pour s’adapter au milieu
aquatique. Il peut se fondre et 
disparaître dans l’élément liquide.

de.name: AQUANA
entry_text:
Es hat sich so entwickelt, dass es
im Wasser leben kann. Im Wasser
selbst wird es unsichtbar.

it.name: VAPOREON
entry_text:
Si è evoluto per adattarsi alla vita
acquatica. Si può sciogliere
nell’acqua diventando invisibile.

es.name: VAPOREON
entry_text:
Ha evolucionado para adaptarse a
la vida acuática. Se mimetiza a
la perfección con el agua.

jp.name: シャワ－ズ
entry_text:
すいちゅうでの　せいかつに　てきした
からだに　しんかした。
みずに　とけると　みえなくなる。

en.name: VENOMOTH
entry_text:
It flutters its wings to scatter
dustlike scales. The scales leach
toxins if they contact skin.

fr.name: AEROMITE
entry_text:
Il répand ses écailles poudreuses
en battant des ailes. Elles sont
toxiques au toucher.

de.name: OMOT
entry_text:
Es schlägt mit den Flügeln, um
staubartige Schuppen abzusondern.
Diese geben bei Kontakt Gift ab.

it.name: VENOMOTH
entry_text:
Sbattendo le ali sparge una
polvere velenosa a contatto
con la pelle.

es.name: VENOMOTH
entry_text:
Agita las alas para dispersar
un polvillo de escamas que
libera toxinas si toca la piel.

jp.name: モルフォン
entry_text:
はばたいて　りんぷんを　まきちらす。
りんぷんが　からだに　つくと　どくの
せいぶんが　ひふに　しみこんでくる。

en.name: VENONAT
entry_text:
Its big eyes are actually clusters
of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is
drawn by light.

fr.name: MIMITOSS
entry_text:
Ses grands yeux sont en fait
des amas d’yeux minuscules. La
nuit, il est attiré par la lumière.

de.name: BLUZUK
entry_text:
Seine großen Augen bestehen aus
vielen kleinen Augen. Nachts wird
es von Licht angezogen.

it.name: VENONAT
entry_text:
I suoi grandi occhi sono in realtà
un insieme di tanti piccoli occhi.
Di notte, è attirato dalla luce.

es.name: VENONAT
entry_text:
Sus grandes ojos son en realidad
grupos de ojos diminutos. Por la
noche se siente atraído por la luz.

jp.name: コンパン
entry_text:
ちいさな　めが　たくさん　あつまって
おおきな　めに　なっている。
よるになると　あかりに　あつまる。

en.name: VENUSAUR
entry_text:
After a rainy day, the flower on
its back smells stronger. The
scent attracts other Pokémon.

fr.name: FLORIZARRE
entry_text:
Le parfum de sa fleur se fait plus
pénétrant les lendemains de pluie.
Cela appâte les autres Pokémon.

de.name: BISAFLOR
entry_text:
Nach einem Regentag riecht die
Blume auf seinem Rücken intensiver.
Das Aroma zieht andere Pokémon an.

it.name: VENUSAUR
entry_text:
Dopo la pioggia, il fiore sul suo
dorso emana un profumo più
intenso e attira gli altri Pokémon.

es.name: VENUSAUR
entry_text:
Después de un día de lluvia, la flor
de su lomo tiene un aroma más
potente y atrae a otros Pokémon.

jp.name: フシギバナ
entry_text:
あめの　ふった　よくじつは　せなかの
はなの　かおりが　つよまる。かおりに
さそわれ　ポケモンが　あつまる。

en.name: VESPIQUEN
entry_text:
It releases various pheromones
to make the grubs in its body do
its bidding while fighting foes.

fr.name: APIREINE
entry_text:
Son abdomen est un rayon où
vivent ses larves, élevées avec
le nectar récolté par APITRINI.

de.name: HONWEISEL
entry_text:
Ihr Bauch ist die Wabe für die
Larven. Sie füttert ihre Larven mit
dem Honig, den WADRIBIE sammelt.

it.name: VESPIQUEN
entry_text:
Il suo addome funge da rifugio per
le larve, che nutre con il nettare
raccolto da COMBEE.

es.name: VESPIQUEN
entry_text:
Su abdomen es un panal de larvas
que alimenta con la miel recogida
por COMBEE.

jp.name: ビ－クイン
entry_text:
どうたいが　こどもたちの　すあなに
なっている。ミツハニ－の　あつめた
ミツで　こどもたちを　そだてる。

en.name: VIBRAVA
entry_text:
It violently shudders its wings,
generating ultrasonic waves to
induce headaches in people.

fr.name: VIBRANINF
entry_text:
Ses violents battements d’ailes
génèrent des vagues d’ultrasons
qui donnent mal au crâne.

de.name: VIBRAVA
entry_text:
Es schlägt wild mit den Flügeln.
So entstehen Ultraschallwellen,
die Kopfschmerzen verursachen.

it.name: VIBRAVA
entry_text:
Fa vibrare violentemente le ali
generando onde ultrasoniche che
provocano il mal di testa.

es.name: VIBRAVA
entry_text:
Agita violentamente sus alas para
crear ondas ultrasónicas que
provocan dolores de cabeza.

jp.name: ビブラ－バ
entry_text:
はねを　はげしく　しんどうさせて
ちょうおんぱを　だす。にんげんも
ずつうを　おこすほど　きょうりょく。

en.name: VICTREEBEL
entry_text:
It pools in its mouth a fluid with
a honeylike scent, which is really
an acid that dissolves anything.

fr.name: EMPIFLOR
entry_text:
Sa bouche sécrète un fluide à
l’odeur de miel, qui s’avère être
un acide extrêmement corrosif.

de.name: SARZENIA
entry_text:
In seinem Maul sammelt sich eine
Flüssigkeit, die nach Honig riecht,
in Wahrheit aber ätzend ist.

it.name: VICTREEBEL
entry_text:
Tiene in bocca un liquido dall’aroma
simile al miele, che in realtà è un
acido altamente corrosivo.

es.name: VICTREEBEL
entry_text:
Su boca segrega un fluido de olor
parecido a la miel: un potente
ácido que disuelve cualquier cosa.

jp.name: ウツボット
entry_text:
ミツのような　かおりの　えきたいを
くちに　ためているが　それは
なんでも　とかす　ようかいえきだ。

en.name: VIGOROTH
entry_text:
Its heart beats at a tenfold
tempo, so it cannot sit still for
even a moment.

fr.name: VIGOROTH
entry_text:
Son cœur bat dix fois plus vite que
la normale, c’est pourquoi il ne
tient pas en place.

de.name: MUNTIER
entry_text:
Sein Herz schlägt schneller als das
anderer Lebewesen. Daher kann es
nicht für einen Moment still sitzen.

it.name: VIGOROTH
entry_text:
Il suo cuore batte 10 volte più
velocemente del normale. Non
sta fermo neanche un momento.

es.name: VIGOROTH
entry_text:
Su corazón late a un ritmo diez
veces más rápido de lo normal.
No se está quieto ni un instante.

jp.name: ヤルキモノ
entry_text:
しんぞうが　１０ばいの　テンポで
こどう　しているため
ひとときも　じっとしていられない。

en.name: VILEPLUME
entry_text:
Its petals are the largest in the
world. As it walks, it scatters
extremely allergenic pollen.

fr.name: RAFFLESIA
entry_text:
Ses pétales sont les plus grands
du monde. Il marche en répandant
un pollen extrêmement allergène.

de.name: GIFLOR
entry_text:
Es besitzt die größten Blätter der
Welt. Es verteilt beim Gehen Pollen,
die schreckliche Allergien auslösen.

it.name: VILEPLUME
entry_text:
I suoi petali sono i più grandi al
mondo. Mentre cammina diffonde
un polline che causa allergie.

es.name: VILEPLUME
entry_text:
Sus pétalos son los más grandes
del mundo. Cuando anda desprende
un terrible polen alergénico.

jp.name: ラフレシア
entry_text:
はなびらの　おおきさは　せかいいち。
ひどい　アレルギ－を　ひきおこす
どくかふんを　ばらまいて　あるく。

en.name: VOLBEAT
entry_text:
It communicates with others by
lighting up its rear at night. It
loves ILLUMISE’s sweet aroma.

fr.name: MUCIOLE
entry_text:
Il communique avec ses pairs en
allumant son postérieur la nuit. Il
adore le doux parfum de LUMIVOLE.

de.name: VOLBEAT
entry_text:
Es kommuniziert mit anderen, indem
es sein Hinterteil zum Leuchten
bringt. Es liebt ILLUMISEs Duft.

it.name: VOLBEAT
entry_text:
Di notte comunica con gli altri
illuminando la sua coda.
Ama il dolce aroma di ILLUMISE.

es.name: VOLBEAT
entry_text:
Se comunica con otros iluminando
su cola por la noche. Le encanta el
suave aroma de ILLUMISE.

jp.name: バルビ－ト
entry_text:
よるになると　おしりを　ひからせ
なかまと　かいわする。イルミ－ゼの
だす　あまい　かおりが　だいすき。

en.name: VOLTORB
entry_text:
It looks just like a Poké Ball.
It is dangerous because it may
electrocute or explode on touch.

fr.name: VOLTORBE
entry_text:
Il ressemble à une Poké Ball. Ce
Pokémon dangereux peut exploser
ou s’électrifier au toucher.

de.name: VOLTOBAL
entry_text:
Sieht aus wie ein Pokéball. Es ist
gefährlich, da es bei Berührung
explodieren kann.

it.name: VOLTORB
entry_text:
Sembra una Poké Ball. Toccandolo si
rischia di prendere la scossa e di
farlo esplodere.

es.name: VOLTORB
entry_text:
Parece una Poké Ball. Es muy
peligroso, ya que puede lanzar
descargas o explotar si se toca.

jp.name: ビリリダマ
entry_text:
モンスタ－ボ－ルに　そっくり。
まちがって　さわると　かんでんしたり
ときには　ばくはつするので　きけん。

en.name: VULPIX
entry_text:
It controls balls of fire. As it
grows, its six tails split from
their tips to make more tails.

fr.name: GOUPIX
entry_text:
Il envoie des boules de feu. Avec
l’âge, ses six queues en forment de
nouvelles.

de.name: VULPIX
entry_text:
Es beherrscht Feuerbälle. Während
es wächst, teilen sich seine sechs
Schweife, um weitere zu bilden.

it.name: VULPIX
entry_text:
Controlla palle infuocate. Via via
che cresce, dalle sue sei code
se ne generano delle altre.

es.name: VULPIX
entry_text:
Controla bolas de fuego. A medida
que crece, sus seis colas se
multiplican.

jp.name: ロコン
entry_text:
ほのおの　たまを　あやつる。
せいちょうすると　６ほんの　しっぽは
さきが　わかれて　さらに　ふえる。

en.name: WAILMER
entry_text:
On sunny days, it lands on beaches
to bounce like a ball and play.
It spouts water from its nose.

fr.name: WAILMER
entry_text:
Par beau temps, il se pose sur les
plages pour jouer et rebondir. Il
expulse de l’eau par son évent.

de.name: WAILMER
entry_text:
An sonnigen Tagen trifft man diese
Pokémon an Stränden, wo sie wie
Bälle herumhüpfen.

it.name: WAILMER
entry_text:
In giornate soleggiate, gioca
rimbalzando sulla spiaggia.
Spruzza acqua dalle narici.

es.name: WAILMER
entry_text:
En días soleados se tumba en las
playas para jugar y botar como una
pelota. Lanza agua por la nariz.

jp.name: ホエルコ
entry_text:
はれた　ひは　すなはまに　あがり
ボ－ルのように　はずんで　あそぶ。
はなから　みずを　ふきあげる。

en.name: WAILORD
entry_text:
The biggest of all Pokémon.
It can dive to a depth of almost
10,000 feet on only one breath.

fr.name: WAILORD
entry_text:
Le plus grand des Pokémon. Il peut
plonger à une profondeur de 
3 000 m en retenant son souffle.

de.name: WAILORD
entry_text:
Das größte PKMN. Es kann mit nur
einem Atemzug in Tiefen bis
3 000 Meter tauchen.

it.name: WAILORD
entry_text:
Il Pokémon più grande che esista.
Dopo aver inalato aria, si immerge a
una profondità di 3000 metri.

es.name: WAILORD
entry_text:
Es el más grande de los Pokémon.
Puede nadar a una profundidad de
3000 m aguantando la respiración.

jp.name: ホエルオ－
entry_text:
いちばん　おおきい　ポケモン。
いきつぎせずに　３０００メ－トルの
ふかさまで　もぐることが　できる。

en.name: WALREIN
entry_text:
It shatters ice with its big tusks.
Its thick blubber repels not only
the cold, but also enemy attacks.

fr.name: KAIMORSE
entry_text:
Il brise la glace avec ses grosses
défenses. Sa graisse le protège du 
froid, mais aussi des attaques.

de.name: WALRAISA
entry_text:
Mit seinen Stoßzähnen bricht es
durch Eis. Eine Speckschicht
schützt es vor Kälte und Angriffen.

it.name: WALREIN
entry_text:
Frantuma il ghiaccio con le zanne.
Lo spesso strato adiposo respinge
il freddo e gli attacchi nemici.

es.name: WALREIN
entry_text:
Rompe el hielo con sus colmillos.
Su gruesa capa de grasa le protege
del frío y de los enemigos.

jp.name: トドゼルガ
entry_text:
おおきな　こおりを　キバで　くだく。
あつい　しぼうは　さむさだけでなく
てきの　こうげきも　はねかえす。

en.name: WARTORTLE
entry_text:
It is said to live 10,000 years.
Its furry tail is popular as a
symbol of longevity.

fr.name: CARABAFFE
entry_text:
On prétend qu’il vit 10 000 ans.
Sa queue duveteuse est un
symbole de longévité populaire.

de.name: SCHILLOK
entry_text:
Man sagt, es werde 10 000 Jahre
alt. Sein buschiger Schweif ist ein
Symbol für langes Leben.

it.name: WARTORTLE
entry_text:
Pare che viva 10000 anni. Ha
la coda ricoperta da una folta
pelliccia, indice di longevità.

es.name: WARTORTLE
entry_text:
Se dice que vive 10000 años.
Su peluda cola es un símbolo de
longevidad.

jp.name: カメ－ル
entry_text:
いちまんねんの　じゅみょうを　もつと
いわれている。ふさふさの　しっぽは
ながいきの　シンボルとして　にんき。

en.name: WEAVILE
entry_text:
Evolution made it even more
devious. It communicates by clawing
signs in boulders.

fr.name: DIMORET
entry_text:
Ils vivent par groupe de 4 ou 5
en région froide et chassent de
façon très organisée.

de.name: SNIBUNNA
entry_text:
Es lebt in kalten Gebieten in
Gruppen von 4 oder 5 PKMN, die bei
der Jagd großes Geschick zeigen.

it.name: WEAVILE
entry_text:
Questi Pokémon vivono in zone fred-
de in gruppi di quattro o cinque.
Insieme sono cacciatori abilissimi.

es.name: WEAVILE
entry_text:
Viven en zonas frías y forman
grupos de cuatro o cinco para
cazar con gran coordinación.

jp.name: マニュ－ラ
entry_text:
さむい　ちいきで　くらす　ポケモン。
４、５ひきの　グル－プは　みごとな
れんけいで　えものを　おいつめる。

en.name: WEEDLE
entry_text:
It eats its weight in leaves every
day. It fends off attackers with
the needle on its head.

fr.name: ASPICOT
entry_text:
Il mange chaque jour son poids en
feuilles. Il utilise l’aiguillon sur sa
tête pour repousser l’ennemi.

de.name: HORNLIU
entry_text:
Es frisst täglich sein Gewicht in
Blättern. Die Nadel auf seinem Kopf
dient der Verteidigung.

it.name: WEEDLE
entry_text:
Divora ogni giorno una quantità di
foglie pari al suo peso. Respinge i
nemici con l’aculeo sulla testa.

es.name: WEEDLE
entry_text:
Come el equivalente a su peso en
hojas todos los días. Se defiende
con el aguijón de su cabeza.

jp.name: ビ－ドル
entry_text:
まいにち　じぶんと　おなじ　おもさの
はっぱを　たべる。あたまの　ハリで
おそってきた　てきを　げきたい。

en.name: WEEPINBELL
entry_text:
A Pokémon that appears to be a
plant. It captures unwary prey by
dousing them with a toxic powder.

fr.name: BOUSTIFLOR
entry_text:
Un Pokémon végétal. Il capture les
proies étourdies en les endormant
à l’aide d’une poudre toxique.

de.name: ULTRIGARIA
entry_text:
Ein Pokémon, das wie eine Pflanze
aussieht. Es fängt Beute, indem es
giftigen Puder darüber verteilt.

it.name: WEEPINBELL
entry_text:
Questo Pokémon sembra una pianta.
Cattura le prede con una polvere
tossica.

es.name: WEEPINBELL
entry_text:
Este Pokémon parece una planta.
Captura a sus presas usando polvo
tóxico cuando están desprevenidas.

jp.name: ウツドン
entry_text:
しょくぶつに　そっくりな　ポケモン。
ゆだんして　ちかよってきた　えものに
どくのこなを　あびせて　つかまえる。

en.name: WEEZING
entry_text:
It grows by feeding on gases
released by garbage. Though very
rare, triplets have been found.

fr.name: SMOGOGO
entry_text:
Il grandit en absorbant les gaz des
détritus. Des triplés existent, bien
qu’ils soient fort rares.

de.name: SMOGMOG
entry_text:
Es wächst, indem es Gase aufnimmt,
die aus dem Müll aufsteigen. Selten
kann man Drillinge von ihnen finden.

it.name: WEEZING
entry_text:
Cresce nutrendosi dei gas emanati
dai rifiuti. Anche se rarissimi, ne
hanno trovati in gruppi di tre.

es.name: WEEZING
entry_text:
Crece alimentándose de los gases
emanados por la basura. Se han
dado raros casos de trillizos.

jp.name: マタドガス
entry_text:
ゴミから　はっせいする　ガスを
たべて　おおきくなる。ごくまれに
３つごの　マタドガスが　みつかる。

en.name: WHISCASH
entry_text:
It is extremely protective of its
territory. If any foe approaches,
it attacks using vicious tremors.

fr.name: BARBICHA
entry_text:
Il est attaché à son territoire.
Il repousse l’ennemi en provoquant
des secousses qui portent à 5 km.

de.name: WELSAR
entry_text:
Es verteidigt sein Revier, indem es
Erschütterungen auslöst, die noch
in 5 km Entfernung zu spüren sind.

it.name: WHISCASH
entry_text:
Ha un senso del territorio molto
sviluppato. Respinge i nemici scate-
nando terremoti del raggio di 5 km.

es.name: WHISCASH
entry_text:
Es muy territorial. Expulsa a los
intrusos con unos temblores que
se sienten en un radio de 5 km.

jp.name: ナマズン
entry_text:
なわばり　いしきが　とても　つよい。
しゅうい　５キロの　はんいで
じしんを　おこし　げきたいする。

en.name: WHISMUR
entry_text:
Usually, its cries are like quiet
murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks
at the same volume as a jet plane.

fr.name: CHUCHMUR
entry_text:
En temps normal, son cri est pareil
à un murmure. Effrayé, il atteint le
volume d’un avion à réaction.

de.name: FLURMEL
entry_text:
Normalerweise klingen seine Rufe
wie Gemurmel. Hat es aber Angst,
ist es so laut wie ein Flugzeug.

it.name: WHISMUR
entry_text:
Di solito ha una voce molto tenue,
ma se si spaventa, emette un suono
assordante quanto un jet.

es.name: WHISMUR
entry_text:
Suele murmurar a un volumen casi
inaudible, pero cuando se asusta
grita con el volumen de un reactor.

jp.name: ゴニョニョ
entry_text:
ふだんは　ささやくような　なきごえ。
ふあんになると　ジェットきと　おなじ
おんりょうで　なきつづける。

en.name: WIGGLYTUFF
entry_text:
Its fine fur feels sublime to the
touch. It can expand its body by
inhaling air.

fr.name: GRODOUDOU
entry_text:
Sa fourrure est d’une douceur
incomparable au toucher. Il 
peut gonfler en aspirant de l’air.

de.name: KNUDDELUFF
entry_text:
Sein feines Fell fühlt sich herrlich
an. Es kann sich größer machen,
indem es Luft einatmet.

it.name: WIGGLYTUFF
entry_text:
Il suo pelo è morbidissimo.
Riesce a gonfiarsi e a ingrandirsi
semplicemente inalando aria.

es.name: WIGGLYTUFF
entry_text:
Tiene un pelaje muy agradable al
tacto. Puede hinchar su cuerpo
tragando aire.

jp.name: プクリン
entry_text:
キメこまやかな　たいもうは
ごくじょうの　はだざわり。
いきを　すいこんで　ふくらむ。

en.name: WINGULL
entry_text:
It soars high in the sky, riding on
updrafts like a glider. It carries
food tucked in its bill.

fr.name: GOELISE
entry_text:
Il niche sur les falaises escarpées
face à la mer. Il vole en altitude
grâce aux courants ascendants.

de.name: WINGULL
entry_text:
Es baut sein Nest auf steilen
Klippen. Es nutzt die Aufwinde, um
in größerer Höhe fliegen zu können.

it.name: WINGULL
entry_text:
Nidifica su scogliere a picco sul
mare. Si fa trasportare ad alta
quota dalle correnti ascensionali.

es.name: WINGULL
entry_text:
Anida en acantilados y alcanza
gran altura aprovechando las
corrientes ascendentes.

jp.name: キャモメ
entry_text:
うみべの　だんがいぜっぺきに
すを　つくる。じょうしょうきりゅうを
りようして　おおぞらに　まいあがる。

en.name: WOBBUFFET
entry_text:
It desperately tries to keep its
black tail hidden. It is said to be
proof the tail hides a secret.

fr.name: QULBUTOKE
entry_text:
Il cherche désespérément à cacher
sa queue noire. Certains pensent
qu’elle renferme un secret.

de.name: WOINGENAU
entry_text:
Verzweifelt versucht es, seinen
schwarzen Schweif zu verstecken.
Er soll ein Geheimnis enthalten.

it.name: WOBBUFFET
entry_text:
Cerca di tenere nascosta la sua
coda nera ad ogni costo. Pare
che essa celi un segreto.

es.name: WOBBUFFET
entry_text:
Siempre intenta ocultar su cola,
por lo que muchos creen que
contiene un secreto.

jp.name: ソ－ナンス
entry_text:
くろい　しっぽを　ひっしになって
かくすのは　しっぽに　ひみつがある
しょうこだと　かんぐられている。

en.name: WOOPER
entry_text:
When walking on land, it covers its
body with a poisonous film that
keeps its skin from dehydrating.

fr.name: AXOLOTO
entry_text:
Il vit en eau froide. Il dort à demi
enfoui dans la boue au fond
de l’eau.

de.name: FELINO
entry_text:
Es lebt im kalten Wasser. Es
vergräbt sich halb im schlammigen
Boden, wenn es schlafen will.

it.name: WOOPER
entry_text:
Vive nell’acqua fredda e quando
vuole dormire si seppellisce a
metà nei fondali melmosi.

es.name: WOOPER
entry_text:
Vive en aguas frías. Para dormir
se entierra a medias en el lodo del
fondo.

jp.name: ウパ－
entry_text:
つめたい　みずの　なかで　くらす。
みずぞこの　どろに　からだを
はんぶん　うずめて　ねむる。

en.name: WORMADAM
entry_text:
When evolving, its body takes in
surrounding materials. As a result,
there are many body variations.

fr.name: CHENISELLE
entry_text:
Quand CHENITI a évolué, sa
cape a fusionné avec son corps.
CHENISELLE ne s’en sépare jamais.

de.name: BURMADAME
entry_text:
Als sich BURMY entwickelte,
wurde sein Umhang Teil des Körpers.
Es legt den Umhang niemals ab.

it.name: WORMADAM
entry_text:
Con l’evoluzione, il manto di BURMY
diventa parte del corpo di questo
Pokémon. Non se ne separa mai.

es.name: WORMADAM
entry_text:
Cuando BURMY evolucionó,
su caparazón pasó a formar parte
de este Pokémon.

jp.name: ミノマダム
entry_text:
ミノムッチから　しんかしたとき
ミノが　からだの　いちぶに　なった。
いっしょう　ミノを　ぬぐことはない。

en.name: WURMPLE
entry_text:
Often targeted by bird Pokémon,
it desperately resists by releasing
poison from its tail spikes.

fr.name: CHENIPOTTE
entry_text:
Il adore manger des feuilles. Si un
ETOURMI l’attaque, il riposte avec
les piquants de son postérieur.

de.name: WAUMPEL
entry_text:
Es isst am liebsten Blätter. Wird es
von einem STARALILI angegriffen,
verteidigt es sich mit Stacheln.

it.name: WURMPLE
entry_text:
Ama mangiare le foglie. Se STARLY lo
attacca, si difende con gli aculei
che ha sulla parte posteriore.

es.name: WURMPLE
entry_text:
Le encanta comer hojas. Si le
ataca un STARLY, se defenderá
con sus púas.

jp.name: ケムッソ
entry_text:
はっぱが　だいこうぶつ。
ムックルに　おそわれたときは
おしりの　トゲで　げきたいする。

en.name: WYNAUT
entry_text:
It grows strong by pushing up
against others en masse.
It loves eating sweet fruit.

fr.name: OKEOKE
entry_text:
Il se muscle en bousculant ses
semblables lors de mêlées. Il
raffole des fruits sucrés.

de.name: ISSO
entry_text:
Es wird stärker, indem es andere
ständig anrempelt. Es liebt
Süßigkeiten.

it.name: WYNAUT
entry_text:
Questi Pokémon si allenano in
gruppo caricandosi l’un l’altro per
rafforzarsi. Amano i frutti dolci.

es.name: WYNAUT
entry_text:
Se fortalecen empujándose unos
a otros en grupos. Les encantan
los dulces.

jp.name: ソ－ナノ
entry_text:
なかまたちと　おしくらまんじゅうを
やることで　がまんづよく　そだつ。
あまい　くだものが　だいこうぶつ。

en.name: XATU
entry_text:
This odd Pokémon can see both
the past and the future. It eyes
the sun’s movement all day.

fr.name: XATU
entry_text:
Cet étrange Pokémon peut voir
l’avenir et le passé. Il guette 
sans cesse la course du soleil.

de.name: XATU
entry_text:
Dieses PKMN kann die Vergangenheit
und die Zukunft sehen. Es
beobachtet ständig die Sonne.

it.name: XATU
entry_text:
Pokémon enigmatico che vede il
passato e prevede il futuro osser-
vando il sole tutto il giorno.

es.name: XATU
entry_text:
Este extraño Pokémon puede ver
el pasado y el futuro. Se pasa el
día mirando al sol.

jp.name: ネイティオ
entry_text:
かこと　みらいを　みとおせる。
まいにち　たいようの　うごきを
みつづけている　ふしぎな　ポケモン。

en.name: YANMA
entry_text:
It can hover in one spot by
flapping its wings at high speed. It
flits about to guard its territory.

fr.name: YANMA
entry_text:
Il voit à 360 degrés sans avoir à
tourner la tête. Il ne loupe jamais
une proie, même dans son dos.

de.name: YANMA
entry_text:
Mit seinen Augen hat es einen Blick-
winkel von 360 Grad. Es sieht sogar
Beute, die sich hinter ihm befindet.

it.name: YANMA
entry_text:
Ha un campo visivo a 360° senza
muovere la testa. Riesce a vedere
persino le prede alle sue spalle.

es.name: YANMA
entry_text:
Su campo visual es de 360 grados
sin girar la cabeza. Detecta hasta
las presas que están a su espalda.

jp.name: ヤンヤンマ
entry_text:
かおを　うごかさずに　３６０ど
すべてを　みわたす　めを　もつので
まうしろの　えものも　みのがさない。

en.name: YANMEGA
entry_text:
Its jaw power is incredible. It is
adept at biting apart foes while
flying by at high speed.

fr.name: YANMEGA
entry_text:
Les ondes de choc qu’il génère
en battant des ailes infligent de
graves blessures internes.

de.name: YANMEGA
entry_text:
Durch die Bewegung seiner Flügel
entstehen Schockwellen, die dem
Gegn. innere Verletzungen zufügen.

it.name: YANMEGA
entry_text:
Agitando le ali crea onde d’urto
che infliggono gravi ferite agli
organi interni dei nemici.

es.name: YANMEGA
entry_text:
Agita sus alas para crear ondas
de choque que producen
lesiones internas a sus rivales.

jp.name: メガヤンマ
entry_text:
はばたいたときの　しょうげきはで
あいての　からだの　うちがわに
ちめいてきな　ダメ－ジを　あたえる。

en.name: ZANGOOSE
entry_text:
It has feuded with SEVIPER for
many generations. Its sharp claws
are its biggest weapons.

fr.name: MANGRIFF
entry_text:
C’est le rival de SEVIPER depuis
des générations. Ses griffes
aiguisées sont son meilleur atout.

de.name: SENGO
entry_text:
Seit Generationen ist es mit
VIPITIS verfeindet. Seine scharfen
Klauen sind seine stärksten Waffen.

it.name: ZANGOOSE
entry_text:
Da generazioni, è acerrimo nemico
di SEVIPER. Gli artigli aguzzi sono
le sue armi più potenti.

es.name: ZANGOOSE
entry_text:
Hace muchos años que se
enfrenta a SEVIPER. Su arma más
eficaz son sus zarpas afiladas.

jp.name: ザング－ス
entry_text:
なんせだいにも　わたって
ハブネ－クと　たたかってきた。
するどい　ツメが　さいだいの　ぶき。

en.name: ZAPDOS
entry_text:
A legendary Pokémon that is said
to live in thunderclouds. It freely
controls lightning bolts.

fr.name: ELECTHOR
entry_text:
Un Pokémon Oiseau légendaire dont
on dit qu’il vit dans les nuages 
d’orage. Il contrôle la foudre.

de.name: ZAPDOS
entry_text:
Ein Legendäres Vogel-Pokémon,
das in Gewitterwolken leben soll.
Es kontrolliert Blitze.

it.name: ZAPDOS
entry_text:
Un Pokémon uccello leggendario.
Si dice che viva tra le nubi tempo-
ralesche. Controlla i fulmini.

es.name: ZAPDOS
entry_text:
Legendario Pokémon pájaro del que
se dice que vive en los nubarrones.
Controla los rayos eléctricos.

jp.name: サンダ－
entry_text:
かみなりぐもの　なかに　いると
いわれる　でんせつの　ポケモン。
カミナリを　じざいに　あやつる。

en.name: ZIGZAGOON
entry_text:
It walks in zigzag fashion. It is
good at finding items in the
grass and even in the ground.

fr.name: ZIGZATON
entry_text:
Il marche en zigzaguant et n’a
pas son pareil pour trouver des
objets dans l’herbe ou sous terre.

de.name: ZIGZACHS
entry_text:
Es läuft im Zickzack. Es hat das
Talent, Items im Gras, aber auch im
Boden, zu finden.

it.name: ZIGZAGOON
entry_text: Avanza a zigzag. È bravo a trovare
strumenti nell’erba e sul terreno.

es.name: ZIGZAGOON
entry_text:
Se mueve en zigzag. Se le da
bien encontrar objetos ocultos en
la hierba e incluso enterrados.

jp.name: ジグザグマ
entry_text:
ジグザグに　あるいて　くさかげや
じめんに　うまっている　たからものを
みつけるのが　とくいな　ポケモン。

en.name: ZUBAT
entry_text:
It checks its surroundings and
location using reflections of the
ultrasonic waves from its mouth.

fr.name: NOSFERAPTI
entry_text:
Bien que dépourvu d’yeux, il
repère les obstacles grâce aux
ultrasons émis par sa gueule.

de.name: ZUBAT
entry_text:
Obwohl es keine Augen hat, kann es
Hindernisse mithilfe von
Ultraschallwellen wahrnehmen.

it.name: ZUBAT
entry_text:
Non ha occhi, ma avverte gli
ostacoli con le onde ultrasoniche
che emette dalla bocca.

es.name: ZUBAT
entry_text:
Aunque carezca de ojos, puede
detectar obstáculos con las ondas
ultrasónicas que emite su boca.

jp.name: ズバット
entry_text:
くちから　だす　ちょうおんぱで
りょうめが　なくても　まわりの
しょうがいぶつを　さっちできる。

ABSORB.name: Absorb
description:
A nutrient-draining
attack. The user’s
HP is restored by
half the damage taken
by the target.

ACID.name: Acid
description:
The foe is attacked
with a spray of harsh
acid. It may also
lower the target’s
Sp. Def stat.

ACID_ARMOR.name: Acid Armor
description:
The user alters its
cellular structure to
liquefy itself,
sharply raising its
Defense stat.

ACUPRESSURE.name: Acupressure
description:
The user applies
pressure to stress
points, sharply
boosting one of its
stats.

AERIAL_ACE.name: Aerial Ace
description:
The user confounds
the foe with speed,
then slashes.
The attack lands
without fail.

AEROBLAST.name: Aeroblast
description:
A vortex of air is
shot at the foe to
inflict damage.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

AGILITY.name: Agility
description:
The user relaxes and
lightens its body to
move faster.
It sharply boosts
the Speed stat.

AIR_CUTTER.name: Air Cutter
description:
The user launches
razorlike wind to
slash the foe.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

AIR_SLASH.name: Air Slash
description:
The user attacks with
a blade of air that
slices even the sky.
It may also make the
target flinch.

AMNESIA.name: Amnesia
description:
The user temporarily
empties its mind to
forget its concerns.
It sharply raises the
user’s Sp. Def stat.

ANCIENT_POWER.name: AncientPower
description:
The user attacks with
a prehistoric power.
It may also raise all
the user’s stats at
once.

AQUA_JET.name: Aqua Jet
description:
The user lunges at
the foe at a speed
that makes it almost
invisible. It is sure
to strike first.

AQUA_RING.name: Aqua Ring
description:
The user envelops
itself in a veil made
of water. It regains
some HP on every
turn.

AQUA_TAIL.name: Aqua Tail
description:
The user attacks by
swinging its tail as if
it were a vicious wave
in a raging storm.

ARM_THRUST.name: Arm Thrust
description:
The user looses a
flurry of open-palmed
arm thrusts that hit
two to five times in a
row.

AROMATHERAPY.name: Aromatherapy
description:
The user releases a
soothing scent that
heals all status
problems affecting
the user’s party.

ASSIST.name: Assist
description:
The user hurriedly
and randomly uses a
move among those
known by other
Pokémon in the party.

ASSURANCE.name: Assurance
description:
If the foe has
already taken some
damage in the same
turn, this attack’s
power is doubled.

ASTONISH.name: Astonish
description:
The user attacks the
foe while shouting in
a startling fashion.
It may also make the
target flinch.

ATTACK_ORDER.name: Attack Order
description:
The user calls out
its underlings to
pummel the foe.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

ATTRACT.name: Attract
description:
If it is the opposite
gender of the user,
the foe becomes
infatuated and less
likely to attack.

AURA_SPHERE.name: Aura Sphere
description:
The user looses a
blast of aura power
from deep within its
body. This move is
certain to hit.

AURORA_BEAM.name: Aurora Beam
description:
The foe is hit with a
rainbow-colored beam.
It may also lower the
target’s Attack
stat.

AVALANCHE.name: Avalanche
description:
An attack move that
inflicts double the
damage if the user
has been hurt by the
foe in the same turn.

BARRAGE.name: Barrage
description:
Round objects are
hurled at the foe to
strike two to five
times in a row.

BARRIER.name: Barrier
description:
The user throws up a
sturdy wall that
sharply raises its
Defense stat.

BATON_PASS.name: Baton Pass
description:
The user switches
places with a party
Pokémon in waiting,
passing along any
stat changes.

BEAT_UP.name: Beat Up
description:
The user gets all the
party Pokémon to
attack the foe. The
more party Pokémon,
the more damage.

BELLY_DRUM.name: Belly Drum
description:
The user maximizes
its Attack stat in
exchange for HP
equal to half its max
HP.

BIDE.name: Bide
description:
The user endures
attacks for two
turns, then strikes
back to cause double
the damage taken.

BIND.name: Bind
description:
A long body or
tentacles are used
to bind and squeeze
the foe for two to
five turns.

BITE.name: Bite
description:
The foe is bitten with
viciously sharp fangs.
It may make the
target flinch.

BLAST_BURN.name: Blast Burn
description:
The foe is razed by
a fiery explosion.
The user must rest
on the next turn,
however.

BLAZE_KICK.name: Blaze Kick
description:
The user launches a
kick with a high
critical-hit ratio.
It may also leave the
target with a burn.

BLIZZARD.name: Blizzard
description:
A howling blizzard is
summoned to strike
the foe.
It may also freeze
the target solid.

BLOCK.name: Block
description:
The user blocks the
foe’s way with arms
spread wide to
prevent escape.

BODY_SLAM.name: Body Slam
description:
The user drops onto
the foe with its full
body weight.
It may leave the foe
paralyzed.

BONE_CLUB.name: Bone Club
description:
The user clubs the
foe with a bone.
It may also make the
target flinch.

BONE_RUSH.name: Bone Rush
description:
The user strikes at
the foe with a hard
bone two to five
times in a row.

BONEMERANG.name: Bonemerang
description:
The user throws the
bone it holds. The
bone loops to hit the
foe twice, coming and
going.

BOUNCE.name: Bounce
description:
The user bounces up
high, then drops on
the foe on the second
turn. It may also
paralyze the foe.

BRAVE_BIRD.name: Brave Bird
description:
The user tucks in
its wings and charges
from a low altitude.
The user also takes
serious damage.

BRICK_BREAK.name: Brick Break
description:
The user attacks with
tough fists, etc. It
can also break any
barrier such as Light
Screen and Reflect.

BRINE.name: Brine
description:
If the foe’s HP is
down to about half,
this attack will hit
with double the
power.

BUBBLE.name: Bubble
description:
A spray of countless
bubbles is jetted at
the foe.
It may also lower the
target’s Speed stat.

BUBBLE_BEAM.name: BubbleBeam
description:
A spray of bubbles is
forcefully ejected
at the foe.
It may also lower the
target’s Speed stat.

BUG_BITE.name: Bug Bite
description:
The user bites the
foe. If the foe is
holding a Berry, the
user eats it and
gains its effect.

BUG_BUZZ.name: Bug Buzz
description:
The user vibrates its
wings to generate a
damaging sound wave.
It may also lower the
foe’s Sp. Def stat.

BULK_UP.name: Bulk Up
description:
The user tenses its
muscles to bulk up
its body, boosting
both its Attack and
Defense stats.

BULLET_PUNCH.name: Bullet Punch
description:
The user strikes
with a tough punch as
fast as a bullet.
This move always goes
first.

BULLET_SEED.name: Bullet Seed
description:
The user forcefully
shoots seeds at the
foe. Two to five
seeds are shot in
rapid succession.

CALM_MIND.name: Calm Mind
description:
The user quietly
focuses its mind and
calms its spirit to
raise its Sp. Atk and
Sp. Def stats.

CAMOUFLAGE.name: Camouflage
description:
The user’s type is
changed depending on
its environment, such
as at water’s edge, in
grass, or in a cave.

CAPTIVATE.name: Captivate
description:
If it is the opposite
gender of the user,
the foe is charmed
into sharply lowering
its Sp. Atk stat.

CHARGE.name: Charge
description:
The user boosts the
power of the Electric
move it uses next.
It also raises the
user’s Sp. Def stat.

CHARGE_BEAM.name: Charge Beam
description:
The user fires a
concentrated bundle
of electricity. It may
also raise the user’s
Sp. Atk stat.

CHARM.name: Charm
description:
The user charmingly
stares at the foe,
making it less wary.
The target’s Attack
is sharply lowered.

CHATTER.name: Chatter
description:
The user attacks
using a sound wave
based on words it has
learned. It may also
confuse the foe.

CLAMP.name: Clamp
description:
The foe is clamped
and squeezed by
the user’s very thick
and sturdy shell for
two to five turns.

CLOSE_COMBAT.name: Close Combat
description:
The user fights the
foe in close without
guarding itself. It
also cuts the user’s
Defense and Sp. Def.

COMET_PUNCH.name: Comet Punch
description:
The foe is hit with
a flurry of punches
that strike two to
five times in a row.

CONFUSE_RAY.name: Confuse Ray
description:
The foe is exposed
to a sinister ray
that triggers
confusion.

CONFUSION.name: Confusion
description:
The foe is hit by a
weak telekinetic
force. It may also
leave the foe
confused.

CONSTRICT.name: Constrict
description:
The foe is attacked
with long, creeping
tentacles or vines.
It may also lower the
target’s Speed.

CONVERSION.name: Conversion
description:
The user changes its
type to become the
same type as one of
its moves.

CONVERSION_2.name: Conversion 2
description:
The user changes its
type to make itself
resistant to the type
of the attack it
last took.

COPYCAT.name: Copycat
description:
The user mimics the
move used immediately
before it. The move
fails if no other move
has been used yet.

COSMIC_POWER.name: Cosmic Power
description:
The user absorbs a
mystical power from
space to raise its
Defense and Sp. Def
stats.

COTTON_SPORE.name: Cotton Spore
description:
The user releases
cottonlike spores
that cling to the
foe, sharply reducing
its Speed stat.

COUNTER.name: Counter
description:
A retaliation move
that counters any
physical attack,
inflicting double the
damage taken.

COVET.name: Covet
description:
The user endearingly
approaches the foe,
then steals the item
the foe is holding.

CRABHAMMER.name: Crabhammer
description:
The foe is hammered
with a large pincer.
This move has a high
critical-hit ratio.

CROSS_CHOP.name: Cross Chop
description:
The user delivers a
double chop with its
forearms crossed.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

CROSS_POISON.name: Cross Poison
description:
A slashing attack
that may also leave
the target poisoned.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

CRUNCH.name: Crunch
description:
The user crunches up
the foe with sharp
fangs. It may also
lower the target’s
Defense stat.

CRUSH_CLAW.name: Crush Claw
description:
The user slashes the
foe with hard and
sharp claws.
It may also lower the
target’s Defense.

CRUSH_GRIP.name: Crush Grip
description:
The foe is crushed
with great force.
The attack is more
powerful the more HP
the foe has left.

CURSE.name: Curse
description:
A move that works
differently for the
Ghost type than for
all the other types.

CUT.name: Cut
description:
The foe is cut with a
scythe or a claw.
It can also be used
to cut down thin
trees.

DARK_PULSE.name: Dark Pulse
description:
The user releases a
horrible aura imbued
with dark thoughts.
It may also make the
target flinch.

DARK_VOID.name: Dark Void
description:
The foe is dragged
into a world of total
darkness that puts it
to sleep.

DEFEND_ORDER.name: Defend Order
description:
The user calls out
its underlings to
shield its body,
raising its Defense
and Sp. Def stats.

DEFENSE_CURL.name: Defense Curl
description:
The user curls up to
conceal weak spots
and raise its Defense
stat.

DEFOG.name: Defog
description:
Obstacles are moved,
reducing the foe’s
evasion stat. It can
also be used to
clear deep fog, etc.

DESTINY_BOND.name: Destiny Bond
description:
When this move is
used, if the user
faints, the foe that
landed the knockout
hit also faints.

DETECT.name: Detect
description:
It enables the user
to evade all attacks.
Its chance of failing
rises if it is used in
succession.

DIG.name: Dig
description:
The user burrows,
then attacks on the
second turn.
It can also be used
to exit dungeons.

DISABLE.name: Disable
description:
For several turns,
this move prevents
the foe from using
the move it last
used.

DISCHARGE.name: Discharge
description:
A flare of electricity
is loosed to strike
all Pokémon in battle.
It may also cause
paralysis.

DIVE.name: Dive
description:
A two-turn attack.
The user dives
underwater on the
first turn, then hits
on the next turn.

DIZZY_PUNCH.name: Dizzy Punch
description:
The foe is hit with
rhythmically launched
punches that may also
leave it confused.

DOOM_DESIRE.name: Doom Desire
description:
Two turns after this
move is used, the
user blasts the foe
with a concentrated
bundle of light.

DOUBLE_EDGE.name: Double-Edge
description:
A reckless, life-
risking tackle.
It also damages the
user by a fairly large
amount, however.

DOUBLE_HIT.name: Double Hit
description:
The user slams the
foe with a tail, etc.
The target is hit
twice in a row.

DOUBLE_KICK.name: Double Kick
description:
The foe is quickly
kicked twice in
succession using both
feet.

DOUBLE_SLAP.name: DoubleSlap
description:
The foe is slapped
repeatedly, back
and forth, two to
five times in a row.

DOUBLE_TEAM.name: Double Team
description:
By moving rapidly, the
user makes illusory
copies of itself to
raise its evasiveness.

DRACO_METEOR.name: Draco Meteor
description:
Comets are summoned
down from the sky.
The attack’s recoil
sharply reduces the
user’s Sp. Atk stat.

DRAGON_BREATH.name: DragonBreath
description:
The user exhales
a mighty gust that
inflicts damage.
It may also paralyze
the target.

DRAGON_CLAW.name: Dragon Claw
description:
The user slashes the
foe with huge, sharp
claws.

DRAGON_DANCE.name: Dragon Dance
description:
The user vigorously
performs a mystic,
powerful dance that
boosts its Attack and
Speed stats.

DRAGON_PULSE.name: Dragon Pulse
description:
The foe is attacked
with a shock wave
generated by the
user’s gaping mouth.

DRAGON_RAGE.name: Dragon Rage
description:
The foe is stricken
by a shock wave.
This attack always
inflicts 40 HP
damage.

DRAGON_RUSH.name: Dragon Rush
description:
The user tackles the
foe while exhibiting
overwhelming menace.
It may also make the
target flinch.

DRAIN_PUNCH.name: Drain Punch
description:
An energy-draining
punch. The user’s
HP is restored by
half the damage taken
by the target.

DREAM_EATER.name: Dream Eater
description:
An attack that works
only on a sleeping
foe. It absorbs half
the damage caused to
heal the user’s HP.

DRILL_PECK.name: Drill Peck
description:
A corkscrewing
attack with the
sharp beak acting
as a drill.

DYNAMIC_PUNCH.name: DynamicPunch
description:
The foe is punched
with the user’s full,
concentrated power.
It confuses the foe
if it hits.

EARTH_POWER.name: Earth Power
description:
The user makes the
ground under the foe
erupt with power.
It may also lower the
target’s Sp. Def.

EARTHQUAKE.name: Earthquake
description:
The user sets off an
earthquake that hits
all the Pokémon in
the battle.

EGG_BOMB.name: Egg Bomb
description:
A large egg is hurled
with maximum force at
the foe to inflict
damage.

EMBARGO.name: Embargo
description:
It prevents the foe
from using its held
item. Its Trainer is
also prevented from
using items on it.

EMBER.name: Ember
description:
The foe is attacked
with small flames.
The target may also
be left with a burn.

ENCORE.name: Encore
description:
The user compels the
foe to keep using
only the move it last
used for three to
seven turns.

ENDEAVOR.name: Endeavor
description:
An attack move that
cuts down the foe’s
HP to equal the
user’s HP.

ENDURE.name: Endure
description:
The user endures any
attack, leaving 1 HP.
Its chance of failing
rises if it is used in
succession.

ENERGY_BALL.name: Energy Ball
description:
The user draws power
from nature and
fires it at the foe.
It may also lower the
target’s Sp. Def.

ERUPTION.name: Eruption
description:
The user attacks in
an explosive fury.
The lower the user’s
HP, the less powerful
this attack becomes.

EXPLOSION.name: Explosion
description:
The user explodes to
inflict damage on all
Pokémon in battle.
The user faints upon
using this move.

EXTRASENSORY.name: Extrasensory
description:
The user attacks with
an odd, unseeable
power.
It may also make the
foe flinch.

EXTREME_SPEED.name: ExtremeSpeed
description:
The user charges the
foe at blinding speed.
This attack always
goes before any
other move.

FACADE.name: Facade
description:
An attack move that
doubles its power if
the user is poisoned,
paralyzed, or has a
burn.

FAINT_ATTACK.name: Faint Attack
description:
The user draws up to
the foe disarmingly,
then throws a sucker
punch.
It hits without fail.

FAKE_OUT.name: Fake Out
description:
An attack that hits
first and makes the
target flinch.
This move works only
on the first turn.

FAKE_TEARS.name: Fake Tears
description:
The user feigns
crying to make the
foe feel flustered,
sharply lowering its
Sp. Def stat.

FALSE_SWIPE.name: False Swipe
description:
A restrained attack
that prevents the
foe from fainting.
The target is left
with at least 1 HP.

FEATHER_DANCE.name: FeatherDance
description:
The user covers the
foe with a mass of
down that sharply
lowers the Attack
stat.

FEINT.name: Feint
description:
An attack that hits a
foe using Protect or
Detect. It also lifts
the effects of those
moves.

FIRE_BLAST.name: Fire Blast
description:
The foe is attacked
with an intense blast
of all-consuming fire.
It may also leave the
target with a burn.

FIRE_FANG.name: Fire Fang
description:
The user bites with
flame-cloaked fangs.
It may also make the
foe flinch or sustain
a burn.

FIRE_PUNCH.name: Fire Punch
description:
The foe is punched
with a fiery fist.
It may leave the
target with a burn.

FIRE_SPIN.name: Fire Spin
description:
The foe becomes
trapped within a
fierce vortex of fire
that rages for two
to five turns.

FISSURE.name: Fissure
description:
The user opens up a
fissure in the ground
and drops the foe in.
The target instantly
faints if it hits.

FLAIL.name: Flail
description:
The user flails about
aimlessly to attack.
It becomes more
powerful the less HP
the user has.

FLAME_WHEEL.name: Flame Wheel
description:
The user cloaks
itself in fire and
charges at the foe.
It may also leave the
target with a burn.

FLAMETHROWER.name: Flamethrower
description:
The foe is scorched
with an intense blast
of fire. The target
may also be left with
a burn.

FLARE_BLITZ.name: Flare Blitz
description:
The user cloaks
itself in fire and
charges at the foe.
The user sustains
serious damage, too.

FLASH.name: Flash
description:
The user flashes a
light that cuts the
foe’s accuracy.
It can also be used
to illuminate caves.

FLASH_CANNON.name: Flash Cannon
description:
The user gathers all
its light energy and
releases it at once.
It may also lower the
foe’s Sp. Def stat.

FLATTER.name: Flatter
description:
Flattery is used to
confuse the foe.
However, it also
raises the target’s
Sp. Atk stat.

FLING.name: Fling
description:
The user flings its
held item at the foe
to attack. Its power
and effects depend
on the item.

FLY.name: Fly
description:
The user soars, then
strikes on the second
turn. It can also be
used for flying to
any familiar town.

FOCUS_BLAST.name: Focus Blast
description:
The user heightens
its mental focus and
unleashes its power.
It may also lower the
target’s Sp. Def.

FOCUS_ENERGY.name: Focus Energy
description:
The user takes a
deep breath and
focuses to raise the
critical-hit ratio of
its attacks.

FOCUS_PUNCH.name: Focus Punch
description:
The user focuses its
mind before launching
a punch. It will fail
if the user is hit
before it is used.

FOLLOW_ME.name: Follow Me
description:
The user draws
attention to itself,
making all foes take
aim only at the user.

FORCE_PALM.name: Force Palm
description:
The foe is attacked
with a shock wave.
It may also leave the
target paralyzed.

FORESIGHT.name: Foresight
description:
Enables the user to
hit a Ghost type with
any type of move. It
also enables the user
to hit an evasive foe.

FRENZY_PLANT.name: Frenzy Plant
description:
The foe is slammed
with an enormous
tree.
The user can’t move
on the next turn.

FRUSTRATION.name: Frustration
description:
A full-power attack
that grows more
powerful the less
the user likes its
Trainer.

FURY_ATTACK.name: Fury Attack
description:
The foe is jabbed
repeatedly with a
horn or beak two to
five times in a row.

FURY_CUTTER.name: Fury Cutter
description:
The foe is slashed
with scythes or
claws. Its power
increases if it hits
in succession.

FURY_SWIPES.name: Fury Swipes
description:
The foe is raked with
sharp claws or
scythes for two to
five times in quick
succession.

FUTURE_SIGHT.name: Future Sight
description:
Two turns after this
move is used, the foe
is attacked with a
hunk of psychic
energy.

GASTRO_ACID.name: Gastro Acid
description:
The user hurls up its
stomach acids on
the foe. The fluid
eliminates the effect
of the foe’s ability.

GIGA_DRAIN.name: Giga Drain
description:
A nutrient-draining
attack. The user’s
HP is restored by
half the damage taken
by the target.

GIGA_IMPACT.name: Giga Impact
description:
The user charges at
the foe using every
bit of its power.
The user must rest
on the next turn.

GLARE.name: Glare
description:
The user intimidates
the foe with the
pattern on its belly
to cause paralysis.

GRASS_KNOT.name: Grass Knot
description:
The user snares the
foe with grass and
trips it. The heavier
the foe, the greater
the damage.

GRASS_WHISTLE.name: GrassWhistle
description:
The user plays a
pleasant melody that
lulls the foe into a
deep sleep.

GRAVITY.name: Gravity
description:
Gravity is intensified
for five turns, making
moves involving flying
unusable and
negating Levitation.

GROWL.name: Growl
description:
The user growls in an
endearing way, making
the foe less wary.
The target’s Attack
stat is lowered.

GROWTH.name: Growth
description:
The user’s body is
forced to grow all at
once. It raises the
Sp. Atk stat.

GRUDGE.name: Grudge
description:
If the user faints,
the user’s grudge
fully depletes the PP
of the foe’s move
that knocked it out.

GUARD_SWAP.name: Guard Swap
description:
The user employs its
psychic power to
switch changes to
its Defense and
Sp. Def with the foe.

GUILLOTINE.name: Guillotine
description:
A vicious, tearing
attack with pincers.
The foe will faint
instantly if this
attack hits.

GUNK_SHOT.name: Gunk Shot
description:
The user shoots
filthy garbage at the
foe to attack.
It may also poison
the target.

GUST.name: Gust
description:
A gust of wind is
whipped up by wings
and launched at the
foe to inflict damage.

GYRO_BALL.name: Gyro Ball
description:
The user tackles the
foe with a high-speed
spin. The slower the
user, the greater
the damage.

HAIL.name: Hail
description:
The user summons a
hailstorm lasting five
turns. It damages all
Pokémon except the
Ice type.

HAMMER_ARM.name: Hammer Arm
description:
The user swings and
hits with its strong
and heavy fist.
It lowers the user’s
Speed, however.

HARDEN.name: Harden
description:
The user stiffens all
the muscles in its
body to raise its
Defense stat.

HAZE.name: Haze
description:
The user creates a
haze that eliminates
every stat change
among all the Pokémon
engaged in battle.

HEAD_SMASH.name: Head Smash
description:
The user delivers a
life-endangering head
butt at full power.
The user also takes
terrible damage.

HEADBUTT.name: Headbutt
description:
The user sticks its
head out and rams
straight forward.
It may make the
foe flinch.

HEAL_BELL.name: Heal Bell
description:
The user makes a
soothing bell chime
to heal the status
problems of all the
party Pokémon.

HEAL_BLOCK.name: Heal Block
description:
The user prevents
the foe from using
any HP-recovery
moves for five turns.

HEAL_ORDER.name: Heal Order
description:
The user calls out
its underlings to heal
it. The user regains
up to half of its
max HP.

HEALING_WISH.name: Healing Wish
description:
The user faints. In
return, the Pokémon
taking its place will
have its HP restored
and status cured.

HEART_SWAP.name: Heart Swap
description:
The user employs its
psychic power to
switch stat changes
with the foe.

HEAT_WAVE.name: Heat Wave
description:
The user exhales a
heated breath on the
foe to attack. It may
also leave the target
with a burn.

HELPING_HAND.name: Helping Hand
description:
A move that boosts
the power of the
ally’s attack in a
Double Battle.

HI_JUMP_KICK.name: Hi Jump Kick
description:
The foe is attacked
with a knee kick from
a jump. If it misses,
the user is hurt
instead.

HIDDEN_POWER.name: Hidden Power
description:
A unique attack that
varies in type and
intensity depending
on the Pokémon using
it.

HORN_ATTACK.name: Horn Attack
description:
The foe is jabbed
with a sharply
pointed horn to
inflict damage.

HORN_DRILL.name: Horn Drill
description:
The foe is stabbed
with a horn rotating
like a drill.
The foe instantly
faints if it hits.

HOWL.name: Howl
description:
The user howls loudly
to raise its spirit,
boosting its Attack
stat.

HYDRO_CANNON.name: Hydro Cannon
description:
The foe is hit with
a watery blast.
The user must rest
on the next turn,
however.

HYDRO_PUMP.name: Hydro Pump
description:
The foe is blasted by
a huge volume of
water launched under
great pressure.

HYPER_BEAM.name: Hyper Beam
description:
The foe is attacked
with a powerful beam.
The user must rest
on the next turn to
regain its energy.

HYPER_FANG.name: Hyper Fang
description:
The user bites hard
on the foe with its
sharp front fangs.
It may also make the
target flinch.

HYPER_VOICE.name: Hyper Voice
description:
The user lets loose
a horribly echoing
shout with the
power to inflict
damage.

HYPNOSIS.name: Hypnosis
description:
The user employs
hypnotic suggestion
to make the target
fall into a deep
sleep.

ICE_BALL.name: Ice Ball
description:
The user continually
rolls into the foe
over five turns. It
becomes stronger
each time it hits.

ICE_BEAM.name: Ice Beam
description:
The foe is struck
with an icy-cold
beam of energy.
It may also freeze
the target solid.

ICE_FANG.name: Ice Fang
description:
The user bites with
cold-infused fangs.
It may also make the
foe flinch or freeze.

ICE_PUNCH.name: Ice Punch
description:
The foe is punched
with an icy fist.
It may leave the
target frozen.

ICE_SHARD.name: Ice Shard
description:
The user flash
freezes chunks of
ice and hurls them.
This move always goes
first.

ICICLE_SPEAR.name: Icicle Spear
description:
The user launches
sharp icicles at the
foe. It strikes two
to five times in a
row.

ICY_WIND.name: Icy Wind
description:
The user attacks with
a gust of chilled air.
It also lowers the
target’s Speed stat.

IMPRISON.name: Imprison
description:
If the foe knows any
move also known by
the user, the foe
is prevented
from using it.

INGRAIN.name: Ingrain
description:
The user lays roots
that restore HP on
every turn.
Because it is rooted,
it can’t switch out.

IRON_DEFENSE.name: Iron Defense
description:
The user hardens
its body’s surface
like iron, sharply
raising its Defense
stat.

IRON_HEAD.name: Iron Head
description:
The foe slams the
target with its
steel-hard head.
It may also make the
target flinch.

IRON_TAIL.name: Iron Tail
description:
The foe is slammed
with a steel-hard
tail. It may also
lower the target’s
Defense stat.

JUDGMENT.name: Judgment
description:
The user releases
countless shots of
light. Its type varies
with the kind of Plate
the user is holding.

JUMP_KICK.name: Jump Kick
description:
The user jumps up
high, then strikes
with a kick. If the
kick misses, the
user hurts itself.

KARATE_CHOP.name: Karate Chop
description:
The foe is attacked
with a sharp chop.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

KINESIS.name: Kinesis
description:
The user distracts
the foe by bending a
spoon.
It may lower the
target’s accuracy.

KNOCK_OFF.name: Knock Off
description:
The user slaps down
the foe’s held item,
preventing the item
from being used
during the battle.

LAST_RESORT.name: Last Resort
description:
This move can be used
only after the user
has used all the
other moves it knows
in the battle.

LAVA_PLUME.name: Lava Plume
description:
An inferno of scarlet
flames washes over
all Pokémon in battle.
It may also inflict
burns.

LEAF_BLADE.name: Leaf Blade
description:
The foe is slashed
with a sharp leaf.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

LEAF_STORM.name: Leaf Storm
description:
A storm of sharp
leaves is whipped up.
The attack’s recoil
sharply reduces the
user’s Sp. Atk stat.

LEECH_LIFE.name: Leech Life
description:
A blood-draining
attack. The user’s
HP is restored by
half the damage taken
by the target.

LEECH_SEED.name: Leech Seed
description:
A seed is planted on
the foe. It steals
some HP from the foe
to heal the user on
every turn.

LEER.name: Leer
description:
The foe is given an
intimidating leer with
sharp eyes.
The target’s Defense
stat is reduced.

LICK.name: Lick
description:
The foe is licked with
a long tongue, causing
damage.
It may also paralyze
the target.

LIGHT_SCREEN.name: Light Screen
description:
A wondrous wall of
light is put up to
suppress damage from
special attacks for
five turns.

LOCK_ON.name: Lock-On
description:
The user takes sure
aim at the foe.
It ensures the next
attack does not fail
to hit the target.

LOVELY_KISS.name: Lovely Kiss
description:
With a scary face,
the user forces a
kiss on the foe.
It may make the
target fall asleep.

LOW_KICK.name: Low Kick
description:
A powerful low kick
that makes the foe
fall over. It inflicts
greater damage on
heavier foes.

LUCKY_CHANT.name: Lucky Chant
description:
The user chants an
incantation toward
the sky, preventing
the foe from landing
critical hits.

LUNAR_DANCE.name: Lunar Dance
description:
The user faints. In
return, the Pokémon
taking its place will
have its status and
HP fully restored.

LUSTER_PURGE.name: Luster Purge
description:
The user looses a
damaging burst of
light. It may also
reduce the target’s
Sp. Def stat.

MACH_PUNCH.name: Mach Punch
description:
The user throws a
punch at blinding
speed.
It is certain to
strike first.

MAGIC_COAT.name: Magic Coat
description:
A barrier reflects
back to the foe
moves like Leech
Seed and moves
that damage status.

MAGICAL_LEAF.name: Magical Leaf
description:
The user scatters
curious leaves that
chase the foe.
This attack will not
miss.

MAGMA_STORM.name: Magma Storm
description:
The foe becomes
trapped within a
maelstrom of fire
that rages for two
to five turns.

MAGNET_BOMB.name: Magnet Bomb
description:
The user launches a
steel bomb that
sticks to the target.
This attack will not
miss.

MAGNET_RISE.name: Magnet Rise
description:
The user levitates
using electrically
generated magnetism
for five turns.

MAGNITUDE.name: Magnitude
description:
The user looses a
ground-shaking quake
affecting everyone in
battle. Its power
varies.

ME_FIRST.name: Me First
description:
The user tries to cut
ahead of the foe to
steal and use the
foe’s intended move
with greater power.

MEAN_LOOK.name: Mean Look
description:
The user affixes the
foe with a dark,
arresting look.
The target becomes
unable to flee.

MEDITATE.name: Meditate
description:
The user meditates
to awaken the power
deep within its body
and raise its Attack
stat.

MEGA_DRAIN.name: Mega Drain
description:
A nutrient-draining
attack. The user’s
HP is restored by
half the damage taken
by the target.

MEGA_KICK.name: Mega Kick
description:
The foe is attacked
by a kick launched
with muscle-packed
power.

MEGA_PUNCH.name: Mega Punch
description:
The foe is slugged
by a punch thrown
with muscle-packed
power.

MEGAHORN.name: Megahorn
description:
Utilizing its tough
and impressive
horn, the user
rams into the foe 
with no letup.

MEMENTO.name: Memento
description:
The user faints upon
using this move.
In return, it sharply
lowers the target’s
Attack and Sp. Atk.

METAL_BURST.name: Metal Burst
description:
The user retaliates
against the foe that
last inflicted damage
on it with much
greater power.

METAL_CLAW.name: Metal Claw
description:
The foe is raked
with steel claws.
It may also raise the
user’s Attack stat.

METAL_SOUND.name: Metal Sound
description:
A horrible sound like
scraping metal is
emitted to sharply
reduce the foe’s
Sp. Def stat.

METEOR_MASH.name: Meteor Mash
description:
The foe is hit with a
hard punch fired
like a meteor.
It may also raise
the user’s Attack.

METRONOME.name: Metronome
description:
The user waggles a
finger and stimulates
the brain into
randomly using nearly
any move.

MILK_DRINK.name: Milk Drink
description:
The user restores its
own HP by up to half
of its maximum HP.
It may also be used
to heal an ally’s HP.

MIMIC.name: Mimic
description:
The user copies the
move last used by
the foe. The move can
be used for the rest
of the battle.

MIND_READER.name: Mind Reader
description:
The user senses the
foe’s movements
with its mind to
ensure its next
attack does not miss.

MINIMIZE.name: Minimize
description:
The user compresses
its body to make
itself look smaller.
The user’s evasion
stat is boosted.

MIRACLE_EYE.name: Miracle Eye
description:
Enables the user to
hit a Dark type with
any type of move. It
also enables the user
to hit an evasive foe.

MIRROR_COAT.name: Mirror Coat
description:
A retaliation move
that counters any
special attack,
inflicting double the
damage taken.

MIRROR_MOVE.name: Mirror Move
description:
The user counters
the foe by mimicking
the move last used
by the foe.

MIRROR_SHOT.name: Mirror Shot
description:
The user looses a
flash of energy from
its polished body.
It may also lower the
target’s accuracy.

MIST.name: Mist
description:
The user cloaks its
body with a white mist
that prevents any of
its stats from being
cut for five turns.

MIST_BALL.name: Mist Ball
description:
A mistlike flurry of
down envelops and
damages the foe. It
may also lower the
target’s Sp. Atk.

MOONLIGHT.name: Moonlight
description:
The user restores its
own HP.
The amount of HP
regained varies with
the weather.

MORNING_SUN.name: Morning Sun
description:
The user restores its
own HP.
The amount of HP
regained varies with
the weather.

MUD_BOMB.name: Mud Bomb
description:
The user launches a
hard-packed mud ball
to attack.
It may also lower the
target’s accuracy.

MUD_SHOT.name: Mud Shot
description:
The user attacks by
hurling a blob of mud
at the foe.
It also reduces the
target’s Speed.

MUD_SLAP.name: Mud-Slap
description:
The user hurls mud in
the foe’s face to
inflict damage and
lower its accuracy.

MUD_SPORT.name: Mud Sport
description:
The user covers
itself with mud. It
weakens Electric-
type moves while the
user is in the battle.

MUDDY_WATER.name: Muddy Water
description:
The user attacks by
shooting out muddy
water.
It may also lower the
foe’s accuracy.

NASTY_PLOT.name: Nasty Plot
description:
The user stimulates
its brain by thinking
bad thoughts.
It sharply raises the
user’s Sp. Atk.

NATURAL_GIFT.name: Natural Gift
description:
The user draws power
to attack by using
its held Berry.
The Berry determines
its type and power.

NATURE_POWER.name: Nature Power
description:
An attack that makes
use of nature’s
power. Its effects
vary depending on the
user’s environment.

NEEDLE_ARM.name: Needle Arm
description:
The user attacks by
wildly swinging its
thorny arms.
It may also make the
target flinch.

NIGHT_SHADE.name: Night Shade
description:
The user makes the
foe see a mirage.
It inflicts damage
matching the user’s
level.

NIGHT_SLASH.name: Night Slash
description:
The user slashes the
foe the instant an
opportunity arises.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

NIGHTMARE.name: Nightmare
description:
A sleeping foe is
shown a nightmare
that inflicts some
damage every turn.

OCTAZOOKA.name: Octazooka
description:
The user attacks by
spraying ink in the
foe’s face or eyes.
It may also lower the
target’s accuracy.

ODOR_SLEUTH.name: Odor Sleuth
description:
Enables the user to
hit a Ghost type with
any type of move. It
also enables the user
to hit an evasive foe.

OMINOUS_WIND.name: Ominous Wind
description:
The user creates a
gust of repulsive
wind. It may also
raise all the user’s
stats at once.

OUTRAGE.name: Outrage
description:
The user rampages
and attacks for two
to three turns.
However, it then
becomes confused.

OVERHEAT.name: Overheat
description:
The user attacks the
foe at full power.
The attack’s recoil
sharply reduces the
user’s Sp. Atk stat.

PAIN_SPLIT.name: Pain Split
description:
The user adds its HP
to the foe’s HP, then
equally shares the
combined HP with the
foe.

PAY_DAY.name: Pay Day
description:
Numerous coins are
hurled at the foe to
inflict damage.
Money is earned
after battle.

PAYBACK.name: Payback
description:
If the user can use
this attack after the
foe attacks, its
power is doubled.

PECK.name: Peck
description:
The foe is jabbed
with a sharply
pointed beak or
horn.

PERISH_SONG.name: Perish Song
description:
Any Pokémon that
hears this song
faints in three turns
unless it switches
out of battle.

PETAL_DANCE.name: Petal Dance
description:
The user attacks by
scattering petals for
two to three turns.
The user then
becomes confused.

PIN_MISSILE.name: Pin Missile
description:
Sharp pins are shot
at the foe in rapid
succession.
They hit two to five
times in a row.

PLUCK.name: Pluck
description:
The user pecks the
foe. If the foe is
holding a Berry, the
user plucks it and
gains its effect.

POISON_FANG.name: Poison Fang
description:
The user bites the
foe with toxic fangs.
It may also leave the
foe badly poisoned.

POISON_GAS.name: Poison Gas
description:
A cloud of poison gas
is sprayed in the
foe’s face.
It may poison the
target.

POISON_JAB.name: Poison Jab
description:
The foe is stabbed
with a tentacle or
arm steeped in
poison. It may also
poison the foe.

POISON_POWDER.name: PoisonPowder
description:
A cloud of poisonous
dust is scattered on
the foe.
It may poison the
target.

POISON_STING.name: Poison Sting
description:
The foe is stabbed
with a poisonous
barb of some sort.
It may also poison
the target.

POISON_TAIL.name: Poison Tail
description:
An attack with a
high critical-hit
ratio. This tail 
attack may also 
poison the foe.

POUND.name: Pound
description:
The foe is physically
pounded with a long
tail or a foreleg,
etc.

POWDER_SNOW.name: Powder Snow
description:
The user attacks with
a chilling gust of
powdery snow.
It may also freeze
the target.

POWER_GEM.name: Power Gem
description:
The user attacks with
a ray of light that
sparkles as if it were
made of gemstones.

POWER_SWAP.name: Power Swap
description:
The user employs its
psychic power to
switch changes to
its Attack and
Sp. Atk with the foe.

POWER_TRICK.name: Power Trick
description:
The user employs its
psychic power to
switch its Attack
with its Defense
stat.

POWER_WHIP.name: Power Whip
description:
The user violently
whirls its vines or
tentacles to harshly
lash the foe.

PRESENT.name: Present
description:
The user attacks by
giving the foe a
booby-trapped gift.
It restores HP
sometimes, however.

PROTECT.name: Protect
description:
It enables the user
to evade all attacks.
Its chance of failing
rises if it is used in
succession.

PSYBEAM.name: Psybeam
description:
The foe is attacked
with a peculiar ray.
It may also leave the
target confused.

PSYCH_UP.name: Psych Up
description:
The user hypnotizes
itself into copying
any stat change
made by the foe.

PSYCHIC.name: Psychic
description:
The foe is hit by a
strong telekinetic
force. It may also
reduce the foe’s
Sp. Def stat.

PSYCHO_BOOST.name: Psycho Boost
description:
The user attacks the
foe at full power.
The attack’s recoil
sharply reduces the
user’s Sp. Atk stat.

PSYCHO_CUT.name: Psycho Cut
description:
The user tears at
the foe with blades
formed by psychic
power. It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

PSYCHO_SHIFT.name: Psycho Shift
description:
Using its psychic
power of suggestion,
the user transfers
its status problems
to the target.

PSYWAVE.name: Psywave
description:
The foe is attacked
with an odd, hot
energy wave.
The attack varies in
intensity.

PUNISHMENT.name: Punishment
description:
This attack’s power
increases the more
the foe has powered
up with stat changes.

PURSUIT.name: Pursuit
description:
An attack move that
inflicts double damage
if used on a foe that
is switching out of
battle.

QUICK_ATTACK.name: Quick Attack
description:
The user lunges at
the foe at a speed
that makes it almost
invisible. It is sure
to strike first.

RAGE.name: Rage
description:
While this move is in
use, it gains attack
power each time the
user is hit in battle.

RAIN_DANCE.name: Rain Dance
description:
The user summons a
heavy rain that falls
for five turns,
powering up Water-
type moves.

RAPID_SPIN.name: Rapid Spin
description:
A spin attack that
can also eliminate
such moves as Bind,
Wrap, Leech Seed,
and Spikes.

RAZOR_LEAF.name: Razor Leaf
description:
Sharp-edged leaves
are launched to slash
at the foe. It has a
high critical-hit
ratio.

RAZOR_WIND.name: Razor Wind
description:
A two-turn attack.
Blades of wind hit the
foe on the second
turn. It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

RECOVER.name: Recover
description:
A self-healing move.
The user restores its
own HP by up to half
of its max HP.

RECYCLE.name: Recycle
description:
The user recycles a
single-use item that
has been used in
battle so it can be
used again.

REFLECT.name: Reflect
description:
A wondrous wall of
light is put up to
suppress damage from
physical attacks for
five turns.

REFRESH.name: Refresh
description:
The user rests
to cure itself of a
poisoning, burn, or
paralysis.

REST.name: Rest
description:
The user goes to
sleep for two turns.
It fully restores the
user’s HP and heals
any status problem.

RETURN.name: Return
description:
A full-power attack
that grows more
powerful the more
the user likes its
Trainer.

REVENGE.name: Revenge
description:
An attack move that
inflicts double the
damage if the user
has been hurt by the
foe in the same turn.

REVERSAL.name: Reversal
description:
An all-out attack
that becomes more
powerful the less
HP the user has.

ROAR.name: Roar
description:
The foe is scared off,
to be replaced by
another Pokémon in
its party. In the
wild, the battle ends.

ROAR_OF_TIME.name: Roar of Time
description:
The user blasts the
foe with power that
distorts even time.
The user must rest
on the next turn.

ROCK_BLAST.name: Rock Blast
description:
The user hurls hard
rocks at the foe.
Two to five rocks are
launched in quick
succession.

ROCK_CLIMB.name: Rock Climb
description:
A charging attack
that may also leave
the foe confused.
It can also be used
to scale rocky walls.

ROCK_POLISH.name: Rock Polish
description:
The user polishes its
body to reduce drag.
It can sharply raise
the Speed stat.

ROCK_SLIDE.name: Rock Slide
description:
Large boulders are
hurled at the foe to
inflict damage.
It may also make the
target flinch.

ROCK_SMASH.name: Rock Smash
description:
The user slugs the
foe with a shattering
punch.
It can also smash
cracked boulders.

ROCK_THROW.name: Rock Throw
description:
The user picks up
and throws a small
rock at the foe to
attack.

ROCK_TOMB.name: Rock Tomb
description:
Boulders are hurled
at the foe. It also
lowers the foe’s
Speed by preventing
its movement.

ROCK_WRECKER.name: Rock Wrecker
description:
The user launches a
huge boulder at the
foe to attack.
It must rest on the
next turn, however.

ROLE_PLAY.name: Role Play
description:
The user mimics the
foe completely,
copying the foe’s
natural ability.

ROLLING_KICK.name: Rolling Kick
description:
The user cuts a
quick spin and lashes
out with a sharp
kick.

ROLLOUT.name: Rollout
description:
The user continually
rolls into the foe
over five turns. It
becomes stronger
each time it hits.

ROOST.name: Roost
description:
The user lands and
rests its body.
It restores the
user’s HP by up to
half of its max HP.

SACRED_FIRE.name: Sacred Fire
description:
The foe is razed with
a mystical fire of
great intensity.
It may also leave the
target with a burn.

SAFEGUARD.name: Safeguard
description:
The user creates a
protective field that
prevents status
problems for five
turns.

SAND_ATTACK.name: Sand-Attack
description:
Sand is hurled in the
foe’s face, reducing
its accuracy.

SING.name: Sing
description:
A soothing lullaby is
sung in a calming
voice that puts the
foe into a deep
slumber.

SAND_TOMB.name: Sand Tomb
description:
The user traps the
foe inside a harshly
raging sandstorm for
two to five turns.

SANDSTORM.name: Sandstorm
description:
A five-turn sand-
storm is summoned
to hurt all combatant
types except Rock, 
Ground, and Steel.

SCARY_FACE.name: Scary Face
description:
The user frightens
the foe with a scary
face to sharply
reduce its Speed
stat.

SCRATCH.name: Scratch
description:
Hard, pointed, and
sharp claws rake the
foe to inflict damage.

SCREECH.name: Screech
description:
An earsplitting
screech is emitted to
sharply reduce the
foe’s Defense stat.

SECRET_POWER.name: Secret Power
description:
The user attacks with
a secret power. Its
added effects vary
depending on the
user’s environment.

SEED_BOMB.name: Seed Bomb
description:
The user slams a
barrage of hard-
shelled seeds
down on the foe
from above.

SEED_FLARE.name: Seed Flare
description:
The user generates
a shock wave from
within its body.
It may also lower the
target’s Sp. Def.

SEISMIC_TOSS.name: Seismic Toss
description:
The foe is thrown
using the power of
gravity. It inflicts
damage equal to
the user’s level.

SELFDESTRUCT.name: Selfdestruct
description:
The user blows up to
inflict damage on all
Pokémon in battle.
The user faints upon
using this move.

SHADOW_BALL.name: Shadow Ball
description:
The user hurls a
shadowy blob at the
foe. It may also
lower the foe’s
Sp. Def stat.

SHADOW_CLAW.name: Shadow Claw
description:
The user slashes with
a sharp claw made
from shadows.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

SHADOW_FORCE.name: Shadow Force
description:
The user disappears,
then strikes the foe
on the second turn.
It hits even if the
foe used Protect.

SHADOW_PUNCH.name: Shadow Punch
description:
The user throws a
punch at the foe from
the shadows.
The punch lands
without fail.

SHADOW_SNEAK.name: Shadow Sneak
description:
The user extends its
shadow and attacks
the foe from behind.
This move always goes
first.

SHARPEN.name: Sharpen
description:
The user reduces its
polygon count to
make itself more
jagged, raising the
Attack stat.

SHEER_COLD.name: Sheer Cold
description:
The foe is attacked
with a blast of
absolute-zero cold.
The foe instantly
faints if it hits.

SHOCK_WAVE.name: Shock Wave
description:
The user strikes the
foe with a quick jolt
of electricity.
This attack cannot be
evaded.

SIGNAL_BEAM.name: Signal Beam
description:
The user attacks with
a sinister beam of
light. It may also
confuse the target.

SILVER_WIND.name: Silver Wind
description:
The foe is attacked
with powdery scales
blown by wind.
It may also raise all
the user’s stats.

SKETCH.name: Sketch
description:
It enables the user
to learn a move used
by the foe.
Once used, the move
Sketch disappears.

SKILL_SWAP.name: Skill Swap
description:
The user employs its
psychic power to
exchange abilities
with the foe.

SKULL_BASH.name: Skull Bash
description:
The user tucks in its
head to raise its
Defense in the first
turn, then rams the
foe on the next turn.

SKY_ATTACK.name: Sky Attack
description:
A second-turn attack
move with a high
critical-hit ratio.
It may also make the
target flinch.

SKY_UPPERCUT.name: Sky Uppercut
description:
The user attacks the
foe with an uppercut
thrown skyward
with force.

SLACK_OFF.name: Slack Off
description:
The user slacks off,
restoring its own HP
by up to half of its
maximum HP.

SLAM.name: Slam
description:
The foe is slammed
with a long tail,
vines, etc., to inflict
damage.

SLASH.name: Slash
description:
The foe is attacked
with a slash of
claws, etc.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

SLEEP_POWDER.name: Sleep Powder
description:
The user scatters a
big cloud of sleep-
inducing dust around
the foe.

SLEEP_TALK.name: Sleep Talk
description:
While it is asleep, the
user randomly uses
one of the moves it
knows.

SLUDGE.name: Sludge
description:
Unsanitary sludge is
hurled at the foe.
It may also poison
the target.

SLUDGE_BOMB.name: Sludge Bomb
description:
The user attacks by
hurling filthy sludge
at the foe.
It may also poison
the target.

SMELLING_SALT.name: SmellingSalt
description:
This attack inflicts
double damage on a
paralyzed foe. It
also cures the foe’s
paralysis, however.

SMOG.name: Smog
description:
The foe is attacked
with a discharge of
filthy gases.
It may also poison
the target.

SMOKE_SCREEN.name: SmokeScreen
description:
The user releases an
obscuring cloud of
smoke or ink.
It reduces the foe’s
accuracy.

SNATCH.name: Snatch
description:
The user steals the
effects of any
healing or stat-
changing move the foe
attempts to use.

SNORE.name: Snore
description:
An attack that can
be used only if the
user is asleep. The
harsh noise may also
make the foe flinch.

SOFTBOILED.name: Softboiled
description:
The user restores its
own HP by up to half
of its maximum HP.
It may also be used
to heal an ally’s HP.

SOLAR_BEAM.name: SolarBeam
description:
A two-turn attack.
The user gathers
light, then blasts a
bundled beam on the
second turn.

SONIC_BOOM.name: SonicBoom
description:
The foe is hit with a
destructive shock
wave that always
inflicts 20 HP damage.

SPACIAL_REND.name: Spacial Rend
description:
The user tears the
foe along with the
space around it.
This move has a high
critical-hit ratio.

SPARK.name: Spark
description:
The user throws an
electrically charged
tackle at the foe.
It may also leave the
target paralyzed.

SPIDER_WEB.name: Spider Web
description:
The user ensnares
the foe with a thin,
gooey silk so it can’t
flee from battle.

SPIKE_CANNON.name: Spike Cannon
description:
Sharp spikes are
fired at the foe to
strike two to five
times in rapid
succession.

SPIKES.name: Spikes
description:
The user lays a trap
of spikes at the
foe’s feet. The trap
hurts foes that
switch into battle.

SPIT_UP.name: Spit Up
description:
The power stored
using the move
Stockpile is released
at once in an attack.

SPITE.name: Spite
description:
The user looses its
grudge on the move
last used by the foe
by cutting 4 PP from
it.

SPLASH.name: Splash
description:
The user just flops
and splashes around
to no effect at all...

SPORE.name: Spore
description:
The user scatters
bursts of spores
that induce sleep.

STEALTH_ROCK.name: Stealth Rock
description:
The user lays a trap
of levitating stones
around the foe. The
trap hurts foes that
switch into battle.

STEEL_WING.name: Steel Wing
description:
The foe is hit with
wings of steel.
It may also raise the
user’s Defense stat.

STOCKPILE.name: Stockpile
description:
The user charges
up power, and raises
both its Defense and
Sp. Def. The move can
be used three times.

STOMP.name: Stomp
description:
The foe is stomped
with a big foot.
It may also make the
target flinch.

STONE_EDGE.name: Stone Edge
description:
The user stabs the
foe with a sharpened
stone. It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

STRENGTH.name: Strength
description:
The foe is slugged
with a punch thrown
at maximum power.
It can also be used
to move boulders.

STRING_SHOT.name: String Shot
description:
The foe is bound with
silk blown from the
user’s mouth.
It reduces the
target’s Speed stat.

STRUGGLE.name: Struggle
description:
An attack that is
used in desperation
only if the user has
no PP. It also hurts
the user slightly.

STUN_SPORE.name: Stun Spore
description:
The user scatters a
cloud of paralyzing
powder.
It may paralyze the
target.

SUBMISSION.name: Submission
description:
The user grabs the
foe and recklessly
dives for the ground.
It also hurts the
user slightly.

SUBSTITUTE.name: Substitute
description:
The user makes a
copy of itself using
some of its HP.
The copy serves as
the user’s decoy.

SUCKER_PUNCH.name: Sucker Punch
description:
This move enables the
user to attack first.
It fails if the foe is
not readying an
attack, however.

SUNNY_DAY.name: Sunny Day
description:
The user intensifies
the sun for five
turns, powering up
Fire-type moves.

SUPER_FANG.name: Super Fang
description:
The user chomps hard
on the foe with its
sharp front fangs.
It cuts the target’s
HP to half.

SUPERPOWER.name: Superpower
description:
The user attacks the
foe with great power.
However, it also
lowers the user’s
Attack and Defense.

SUPERSONIC.name: Supersonic
description:
The user generates
odd sound waves from
its body.
It may confuse the
target.

SURF.name: Surf
description:
It swamps the entire
battlefield with a
giant wave.
It can also be used
for crossing water.

SWAGGER.name: Swagger
description:
The user enrages the
foe into confusion.
However, it also
sharply raises the
foe’s Attack stat.

SWALLOW.name: Swallow
description:
The power stored
using the move
Stockpile is absorbed
by the user to heal
its HP.

SWEET_KISS.name: Sweet Kiss
description:
The user kisses the
foe with a sweet,
angelic cuteness that
causes confusion.

SWEET_SCENT.name: Sweet Scent
description:
A sweet scent that
lowers the foe’s
evasiveness. It also
lures wild Pokémon
if used in grass, etc.

SWIFT.name: Swift
description:
Star-shaped rays are
shot at the foe.
This attack never
misses.

SWITCHEROO.name: Switcheroo
description:
The user trades held
items with the foe
faster than the eye
can follow.

SWORDS_DANCE.name: Swords Dance
description:
A frenetic dance to
uplift the fighting
spirit. It sharply
raises the user’s
Attack stat.

SYNTHESIS.name: Synthesis
description:
The user restores its
own HP.
The amount of HP
regained varies with
the weather.

TACKLE.name: Tackle
description:
A physical attack
in which the user
charges and slams
into the foe with
its whole body.

TAIL_GLOW.name: Tail Glow
description:
The user stares at
flashing lights to
focus its mind,
sharply raising its
Sp. Atk stat.

TAIL_WHIP.name: Tail Whip
description:
The user wags its tail
cutely, making the
foe less wary.
The target’s Defense
stat is lowered.

TAILWIND.name: Tailwind
description:
The user whips up a
turbulent whirlwind
that ups the Speed
of all party Pokémon
for three turns.

TAKE_DOWN.name: Take Down
description:
A reckless, full-body
charge attack for
slamming into the foe.
It also damages the
user a little.

TAUNT.name: Taunt
description:
The foe is taunted
into a rage that
allows it to use only
attack moves for two
to four turns.

TEETER_DANCE.name: Teeter Dance
description:
The user performs a
wobbly dance that
confuses all the
Pokémon in battle.

TELEPORT.name: Teleport
description:
Use it to flee from
