any wild Pokémon.
It may also be used
to warp to the last
Poké Center visited.

THIEF.name: Thief
description:
The user attacks and
steals the foe’s held
item simultaneously.
It can’t steal if the
user holds an item.

THRASH.name: Thrash
description:
The user rampages
and attacks for two
to three turns.
It then becomes
confused, however.

THUNDER.name: Thunder
description:
A wicked thunderbolt
is dropped on the foe
to inflict damage.
It may also leave the
target paralyzed.

THUNDER_FANG.name: Thunder Fang
description:
The user bites with
electrified fangs.
It may also make the
foe flinch or become
paralyzed.

THUNDER_PUNCH.name: ThunderPunch
description:
The foe is punched
with an electrified
fist. It may leave
the target with
paralysis.

THUNDER_SHOCK.name: ThunderShock
description:
A jolt of electricity
is hurled at the foe
to inflict damage.
It may also leave the
foe paralyzed.

THUNDER_WAVE.name: Thunder Wave
description:
A weak electric
charge is launched at
the foe.
It causes paralysis if
it hits.

THUNDERBOLT.name: Thunderbolt
description:
A strong electric
blast is loosed at
the foe.
It may also leave the
foe paralyzed.

TICKLE.name: Tickle
description:
The user tickles the
foe into laughing,
reducing its Attack
and Defense stats.

TORMENT.name: Torment
description:
The user torments
and enrages the foe,
making it incapable of
using the same move
twice in a row.

TOXIC.name: Toxic
description:
A move that leaves
the target badly
poisoned.
Its poison damage
worsens every turn.

TOXIC_SPIKES.name: Toxic Spikes
description:
The user lays a trap
of poison spikes at
the foe’s feet. They
poison foes that
switch into battle.

TRANSFORM.name: Transform
description:
The user transforms
into a copy of the
foe right down to
having the same move
set.

TRI_ATTACK.name: Tri Attack
description:
The user strikes with
a simultaneous three-
beam attack. May also
paralyze, burn, or
freeze the target.

TRICK.name: Trick
description:
The user catches the
foe off guard and
swaps the foe’s held
item with its own.

TRICK_ROOM.name: Trick Room
description:
The user creates a
bizarre area in which
slower Pokémon get
to move first for five
turns.

TRIPLE_KICK.name: Triple Kick
description:
A consecutive three-
kick attack that
becomes more
powerful with each 
successive hit.

TRUMP_CARD.name: Trump Card
description:
The fewer PP this
move has, the more
power it has for
attack.

TWINEEDLE.name: Twineedle
description:
The foe is stabbed
twice by a pair of
stingers.
It may also poison
the target.

TWISTER.name: Twister
description:
The user whips up a
vicious twister to
tear at the foe.
It may also make the
foe flinch.

U_TURN.name: U-turn
description:
After making its
attack, the user
rushes back to switch
places with a party
Pokémon in waiting.

UPROAR.name: Uproar
description:
The user attacks in
an uproar for two to
five turns. Over that
time, no one can fall
asleep.

VACUUM_WAVE.name: Vacuum Wave
description:
The user whirls its
fists to send a wave
of pure vacuum at
the foe. This move
always goes first.

VICE_GRIP.name: ViceGrip
description:
Huge, impressive
pincers grip and
squeeze the foe.

VINE_WHIP.name: Vine Whip
description:
The foe is struck
with slender, whiplike
vines to inflict
damage.

VITAL_THROW.name: Vital Throw
description:
The user allows the
foe to attack first.
In return, this throw
move is guaranteed
not to miss.

VOLT_TACKLE.name: Volt Tackle
description:
The user electrifies
itself, then charges
at the foe. It causes
considerable damage
to the user as well.

WAKE_UP_SLAP.name: Wake-Up Slap
description:
This attack inflicts
high damage on a
sleeping foe. It
also wakes the foe
up, however.

WATER_GUN.name: Water Gun
description:
The foe is blasted
with a forceful shot
of water.

WATER_PULSE.name: Water Pulse
description:
The user attacks the
foe with a pulsing
blast of water.
It may also confuse
the foe.

WATER_SPORT.name: Water Sport
description:
The user soaks itself
with water. The move
weakens Fire-type
moves while the user
is in the battle.

WATER_SPOUT.name: Water Spout
description:
The user spouts
water to damage the
foe. The lower the
user’s HP, the less
powerful it becomes.

WATERFALL.name: Waterfall
description:
The user charges the
foe at an awesome
speed.
It can also be used
to climb a waterfall.

WEATHER_BALL.name: Weather Ball
description:
An attack move that
varies in power and
type depending on
the weather.

WHIRLPOOL.name: Whirlpool
description:
The user traps the
foe inside a fast,
vicious whirlpool that
lasts for two to five
turns.

WHIRLWIND.name: Whirlwind
description:
The foe is blown away,
to be replaced by
another Pokémon
in its party. In the
wild, the battle ends.

WILL_O_WISP.name: Will-O-Wisp
description:
The user shoots a
sinister, bluish white
flame at the foe to
inflict a burn.

WING_ATTACK.name: Wing Attack
description:
The foe is struck
with large, imposing
wings spread wide
to inflict damage.

WISH.name: Wish
description:
A self-healing move.
The user restores its
own HP by up to half
of its maximum HP
in the next turn.

WITHDRAW.name: Withdraw
description:
The user withdraws
its body into its hard
shell, raising its
Defense stat.

WOOD_HAMMER.name: Wood Hammer
description:
The user slams its
rugged body into the
foe to attack. The
user also sustains
serious damage.

WORRY_SEED.name: Worry Seed
description:
A seed that causes
worry is planted on
the foe. It prevents
sleep by making its
ability Insomnia.

WRAP.name: Wrap
description:
A long body or vines
are used to wrap and
squeeze the foe for
two to five turns.

WRING_OUT.name: Wring Out
description:
The user powerfully
wrings the foe.
The more HP the foe
has, the greater this
attack’s power.

X_SCISSOR.name: X-Scissor
description:
The user slashes at
the foe by crossing
its scythes or claws
as if they were a pair
of scissors.

YAWN.name: Yawn
description:
The user lets loose a
huge yawn that lulls
the foe into falling
asleep on the next
turn.

ZAP_CANNON.name: Zap Cannon
description:
The user fires an
electric blast like a
cannon to inflict
damage and cause
paralysis.

ZEN_HEADBUTT.name: Zen Headbutt
description:
The user focuses its
willpower to its head
and rams the foe.
It may also make the
target flinch.
